# Does It ARM

> Does It ARM tracks whether Mac apps, games and Homebrew formulae run natively on Apple silicon (M-series and A-series Macs), run through Rosetta 2, or are unsupported.

Each listing has a page at https://doesitarm.com/app/<slug>, /game/<slug> or /formula/<slug> with a status headline, per-device support, links and related benchmark videos.

## MCP server

- [Does It ARM MCP server](https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp): public, read-only Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, no auth. Tools: search_apps, get_app, check_apps, list_categories, list_by_category, recent_updates, list_devices.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/ThatGuySam/doesitarm/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): Claude Code `claude mcp add --transport http doesitarm https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp`
